set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system login user [parameter1].explanation: This command fragment configures a user account on a Junos device, where `[parameter1]` specifies the username for login authentication and management access.

class [parameter2].explanation: Configure the type of system login user.

authentication encrypted-password [param.explanation: The command sets an encrypted password for user authentication, where `[parameter2]` specifies the encrypted password string to be used.

set system services [parameter1].explanation: Enable system services such as SSH.

set firewall family inet filter [paramet.explanation: This command fragment configures an IPv4 firewall filter named `[parameter1]` in Junos OS, defining rules to control traffic based on specified conditions.

term [parameter2].explanation: This command fragment creates a term within an IPv4 firewall filter, where `[parameter1]` is the filter name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

from source-address [parameter3].explanation: The command filters traffic based on the specified source IP address (`[parameter3]`), allowing or denying packets originating from that address in a Junos configuration.

then [parameter3].explanation: Configure firewall filter terminologies and accept all traffic.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: Action, accept indicates acceptance of traffic.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

family inet filter input [parameter3].explanation: Configure the input filter for the interface.

set access class [parameter1].explanation: This command fragment assigns a predefined access control list (ACL) named `[parameter1]` to control traffic flow or restrict access on a Junos device.

acl-name [parameter2].explanation: Configure the ACL name for the access control class.
